notes.title: Road Map + Summary of Patch .01 & .02
notes.notes:
2025-2026 Road Map
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631651/bf98f8dfa241deb38ccae041ecef5ad1d36d5e1e.png"]
Patch .01
❀ A compass has been added to the HUD

❀ The player icon on the map has been changed to a triangle/pointer so you know which direction you're facing while having the journal open

❀ While menus are open time pause now pauses

❀ The bug lantern has been replaced with an interactable flower lantern. We added a mini-mechanic to test out how we want to reflect the lore in other aspects of gameplay.

❀ Fixed an issue with multiple inputs interacting with each other

❀ Various interactable objects are interactable again (lootable bags, world seeds)


Patch .02
❀ Fixed an issue in .01 that caused a gravity issue with the jumping

❀ Mouse lag is now significantly less



Join our Discord  for details on future updates and to give your feedback!

Report bugs here!
